d: US Ambassador Sergio Gor is in the spotlight after revealing details of the Modi-Trump bilateral at the G7 summit in France. Gor said Trump agreed to India’s request for no post-meeting press conference, but later forgot and took questions from reporters. His recent remarks calling Kashmir an “important part of India” have also drawn attention. So, why does Gor stand apart from previous US ambassadors, and what is his connection to Donald Trump? Hem Kaur Saroya explains.
